title: fix: Graphiti not agent-usable (empty graph, stripped provenance, search hang)

defects.evidence: 5 approved seed episodes --apply-ingested; live Episodic group counts now: decisions_graphiti-memory-boundary, homelab_nippon-quorum, incidents_media-stack, services_graphiti, services_vaultwarden, plus the pre-existing smoke group. Entity count went 2 -> 17.

defects.root_cause: graphiti-core 0.30.2 build_indices_and_constraints() creates only RANGE + FULLTEXT indexes (graph_queries.py get_range_indices/get_fulltext_indices); it never creates a VECTOR index, leaving fact_embedding (1536-dim relationship property) unindexed and vector.similarity.cosine brute-force.
defects.evidence: Created fact_embedding_vector (VECTOR, RELATIONSHIP, RELATES_TO.fact_embedding, 1536-dim cosine) via new idempotent script scripts/ensure-vector-index.sh; SHOW INDEXES WHERE type='VECTOR' now returns it ONLINE at populationPercent 100.0. /search observed ~0.8-1.5s across repeated runs (was 120s+ hang / HTTP 000).

normalize_results() now reads the real /search shape (facts[] with episodes[]; no group_id/source_ref/source_episode) and resolves provenance via GET /episodes/{group_id} (episode name -> source_episode, source_description -> source_ref, group_id -> group). Live query now returns source_episode, source_ref, group, valid_at, domain all populated.

Curated services.graphiti seed lives in wire group services_graphiti; wrapper _wire_group_id maps dotted<->underscore consistently on both query and ingest, and normalize_results prefers the caller's dotted fallback_group. Documented agent group services.graphiti now returns real facts.

tests.unit: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/graphiti/tests -v -> 7/7 pass (incl. refactored provenance regression test reflecting the real /search facts[]/episodes[] shape)

known_artifact.duplicate_decisions_episode: First --apply (8s default timeout) committed server-side before the client timed out; the 120s retry re-ingested, leaving one near-duplicate episode in decisions_graphiti-memory-boundary (facts differ only by a leading 'Hermes '). Left in place per safety boundary: live DELETE is not run against curated (non-disposable) content without explicit approval. Query returns both; harmless dedupe follow-up if Ben wants it.
